mapper.select: SELECT id, knowledge_id AS knowledgeId, index_version AS indexVersion, embedding_profile_id AS embeddingProfileId, embedding_profile_revision AS embeddingProfileRevision, multimodal_embedding_profile_id AS multimodalEmbeddingProfileId, multimodal_embedding_profile_revision AS multimodalEmbeddingProfileRevision, splitter_config AS splitterConfig, status, document_count AS documentCount, fragment_count AS fragmentCount, activated_at AS activatedAt, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM knowledge_index_version WHERE knowledge_id = #{knowledgeId} AND status != #{deletedStatus} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT /* knowledge_periodic_scan */ id, knowledge_id, index_version, embedding_profile_id, embedding_profile_revision, multimodal_embedding_profile_id, multimodal_embedding_profile_revision, rerank_profile_id, rerank_profile_revision, splitter_config, status, document_count, fragment_count, activated_at, create_time, update_time FROM knowledge_index_version WHERE status IN ('BUILDING', 'READY', 'ACTIVE') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, knowledge_id, index_version, embedding_profile_id, embedding_profile_revision, multimodal_embedding_profile_id, multimodal_embedding_profile_revision, rerank_profile_id, rerank_profile_revision, splitter_config, status, document_count, fragment_count, activated_at, create_time, update_time FROM knowledge_index_version WHERE knowledge_id = #{knowledgeId} AND index_version = #{indexVersion} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, knowledge_id, index_version, embedding_profile_id, embedding_profile_revision, multimodal_embedding_profile_id, multimodal_embedding_profile_revision, rerank_profile_id, rerank_profile_revision, splitter_config, status, document_count, fragment_count, activated_at, create_time, update_time FROM knowledge_index_version WHERE knowledge_id = #{knowledgeId} AND index_version = #{indexVersion} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_index_version SET status = #{archivedStatus} WHERE knowledge_id = #{knowledgeId} AND status = #{activeStatus} AND id != #{excludeId}

UPDATE knowledge_document d JOIN knowledge_index_document m ON m.document_id = d.id AND m.index_version_id = #{indexVersionId} JOIN knowledge_document_version v ON v.id = m.document_version_id AND v.document_id = d.id AND v.knowledge_id = d.knowledge_id SET d.current_version_id = v.id, d.current_version_no = v.version_no, d.status = 'READY', d.update_time = NOW() WHERE d.status != 'DELETED'
